assertions.description: Output follows Iron Law: no fix without root cause investigation

Output does NOT tell the author to replace db.transaction() with db.batch(). Splitting related writes into independent statements to dodge a driver-capability error is the wrong fix: it turns an atomic update (a ledger mirror plus a stock deduction) into a half-appliable one, which is the damage the old 'no transactions on HTTP serverless drivers' rule existed to prevent. The correct answer verifies which driver the connection module imports before touching any call site. Asserting not_contains db.transaction() instead would fail every correct answer about atomic writes.
Output references quality gates (type-check, lint, test)
Output prefers CDP attach for session-bound pages (agent-browser --cdp), not headless-only
Output references snapshot-before-interaction for agent-browser
Output uses agent-browser default browser session for public pages
Output does NOT use console.log in fix suggestions (stability rule H)
Output does NOT use non-null assertion ! on optional data (stability rule B)
Output guards .returning()[0] access against empty arrays (stability rule C)
Output selects correct pack based on symptom type
Output references one fix at a time principle
assertions.check: contains_one_of: ["one change", "one fix", "uma correcao", "minimal fix", "smallest possible"]

assertions.description: Output does NOT use as any to silence type errors (stability rule I)
Output length is under 800 words for focused responses
Output references evidence confirmation (screenshot or DB validation)
Scanner-led React cleanup without a concrete runtime symptom routes to /perf doctor
The render-health probe runs only after the reproducer exists
Scanner findings remain evidence for hypotheses rather than automatic root causes
An absent render-health command is skipped without installing or inventing a scanner
Render-health evidence supplements rather than replaces project gates and runtime evidence
The configured render-health command is executed literally
Concrete frontend incidents preserve the pack, root-cause, gate, and browser-evidence floors
An absent capability is not replaced by an installation or invented scanner command
